div.span:
Crow's Foot notation
|| = exactly one
o| = zero or one
o{ = zero or many
PK = primary key · FK = foreign key · UK = unique key

ROUTING_CONFIGS
PK id : uuid
document_type : text
workflow_version : int
review_deadline_hours : int

WORKFLOW_STEPS
PK id : uuid
document_type : text
workflow_version : int
step_order : int
label : text

STEP_ASSIGNEES
PK id : uuid
FK step_id : uuid
FK user_id : uuid
is_primary : boolean
backup_rank : int

USERS
PK id : uuid
name : text
role : text
department_id : text

PERMISSIONS
PK id : uuid
role_id : text
FK user_id : uuid
document_type : text
action : text
granted : boolean

DOCUMENTS
PK id : uuid
UK document_number : text
document_type : text
title : text
FK created_by : uuid
FK current_holder_id : uuid
current_step : int
status : text
deadline_time : timestamptz

ROUTING_RECORDS
PK id : uuid
FK document_id : uuid
step_order : int
FK assigned_to : uuid
status : text

DOCUMENT_HISTORY
PK id : uuid
FK document_id : uuid
FK actor_id : uuid
action : text
from_status : text
to_status : text
created_at : timestamptz

NOTIFICATIONS
PK id : uuid
FK document_id : uuid
FK user_id : uuid
type : text
read : boolean

DOCUMENT_CONTENTS
PK, FK document_id : uuid
pages : jsonb
revision : int
FK updated_by : uuid

SIGNATURE_ASSETS
PK id : uuid
FK owner_user_id : uuid
image_bytes : bytea
mime_type : text
is_saved : boolean

SIGNATURE_FIELDS
PK id : uuid
FK document_id : uuid
FK assigned_signer_id : uuid
FK signature_asset_id : uuid
signed_at : timestamptz
